# Vendored Chronicon

Upstream: https://github.com/19-84/chronicon

This directory preserves the exact Chronicon 1.0.1 package sources used for the approved Bokeh archive. The upstream package source, packaging metadata, README, and Unlicense are retained. Generated Python bytecode is excluded.

No local checkout or editable dependency is required. Install this copy through the repository's `requirements-build.txt`.
